atoms.body: You are the director-builder of a CETI motion film in Kinetic Hydrography 1.0.0. You turn the stitched pieces below into one storyboard and then into a working film in films/kh/caps/<slug>/ (film.js + score.py + NOTES.md) that passes every gate in films/kh/caps/tool.cjs. The pieces were chosen by a jury from 100 storyboards; keep their intent, make them cohere, and fix what does not glue.

Deliver: (1) storyboards/final/<slug>.json validating against films/storyboards/SCHEMA.json; (2) the film in films/kh/caps/<slug>/ per films/kh/caps/AGENT-BRIEF.md and films/kh/caps/LONGFORM-60.md (acts on the 32-bar grid, all gates PASS incl. the new LONGFORM gates you can check mechanically); (3) a contact sheet you have looked at and iterated twice; (4) NOTES.md listing which stitched piece each act came from (atom id) and every change you made to a piece and why.
Problem first: the first 4 s show a consequence someone feels, captioned in their words. No title before bar 6.
Every jargon word is pictured before it is named; no jargon in FELT or WHY.
Captions ≤ 8 words, plain verbs, no units; the last WHY caption states the move in plain words.
Numbers only on a 'Real run · source' card with their source, or labelled 'Illustration'. Never invent a statistic.
The honest limit is shown as a picture (something gets through), then the not-this line.

Kinetic Hydrography: KH tokens and Wada mixes only (no hex literals), CETI eases only, text ink on paper or on SERIES.chip, chart ground, the whale and one line; ≥ 4.5:1 contrast; phone-legible sizes.
Slow down, filter noise: one focal event per bar in FELT and WHY, per beat in MOVE and CASE; the three-times device shows 'keeps happening'.
One focal point per moment; nothing overlaps a caption; the whale never covers the word it lands on.

Make Conserve-60: the one-minute, problem-first version of 'Change everything but the laws' — a knowledge base people stop trusting because edits silently break links, duplicate pages and drop sources; the move: name the few things that must never change and check them on every edit (Noether-inspired, never 'Noether's theorem').

Make Stitch-60: the one-minute, problem-first version of 'Context is composed' — agents given a pasted heap of context quote drafts as decisions and mix sources; the move: build the brief from small labelled parts that only fit where their type matches, checked at every seam, with a receipt.

Make Gate v3 (25–30 s, the 25-s series format, not 60 s): 'Check it at the gate' made clearer — each gate checks a DIFFERENT kind of thing; the escape is a smooth run of the wrong kind (like a page that declared one font and rendered another); the miss becomes a new KIND of check, not a tighter slot. Apply films/kh/caps/gate/REVIEW-v3.md.
